entries.name: Spirit of the Assassin
entries.text:
On Powered Melee Kill:
Grants Void Invisibility for 7 seconds.

On Finisher:
Grants Void Invisibility for 10 seconds

entries.name: Spirit of the Star-Eater
entries.text:
Picking up an Orb of Power while Super is charged grants a stack of Feast of Light, up to a maximum of x6 stacks.
Swapping to another Exotic Class Item with Star-Eaters will maintain the current Feast of Light stacks.

On Super Cast:
Consumes all Feast of Light stacks, increasing Super Damage for 14 seconds.
18.2% | 36.4% | 54.6% | 59.7% | 64.8% | 70% increased Super Damage.

Reduced effectiveness with certain Super Abilities.
Song of Flame does not receive increased Solar Effect Damage.
Nova Bomb, Thundercrash, and Twilight Arsenal receive up to 50% Increased Super Damage.
Needlestorm receives up to 35% Increased Super Damage.

entries.name: Spirit of the Inmost Light
entries.text:
On Grenade or Class Ability Usage, or upon dealing Powered Melee Damage:
Grants a stack of Empowered Abilities for the other two abilities for 5 seconds, up to 2 stacks.
e.g.: Dealing Combination Blow damage -> Increased Grenade and Class Ability Regeneration.

Empowered Abilities:
x1 = 400% [100%] | x2 = 800% [200%] Additional Base Grenade and Melee Regeneration Rate.
x1 = 25% | x2 = 50% Additional Base Class Ability Regeneration Rate.

Buff display is NOT accurate to the active ability regen.
With the example in mind, Class Ability Usage before Empowered x1 from Melee runs out will do the following:
Grenade Empower will go to x2 and will have its duration refreshed. Melee will receive Empower x1 for 5 seconds, and Class Empower x1 won't be refreshed, despite the UI saying Empowered x2

entries.name: Spirit of the Synthoceps
entries.text:
While within 15 metres of 3 enemies:
Grants Biotic Enhancements for 5 seconds.

Biotic Enhancements:
165% [100%] Increased Melee Damage.

Decreased effectiveness with Lightning Surge against Guardians.

entries.name: Spirit of the Ophidian
entries.text: Passively grants +35 Handling.

entries.name: Spirit of Verity
entries.text:
Upon scoring a Grenade-Element Matching Weapon Kill:
Grants a stack of Death Throes, up to 5 stacks, increasing Grenade Ability Damage and granting Bonus Grenade Ability Energy per second per stack.
Loses 1 Death Throes stack upon expiring, rather than all of them.
Death Throes stack timer begins decaying after 2 seconds of gaining a stack.

Death Throes:
x1 = 40% [20%] increased Grenade Damage, +0.5% Bonus Grenade Energy/s for 8 seconds.
x2 = 55% [40%] increased Grenade Damage, +1% Bonus Grenade Energy/s for 7 seconds.
x3 = 70% [60%] increased Grenade Damage, +1.5% Bonus Grenade Energy/s for 6 seconds.
x4 = 85% [80%] increased Grenade Damage, +2% Bonus Grenade Energy/s for 5 seconds.
x5 = 100% increased Grenade Damage, +2.5% Bonus Grenade Energy/s for 4 seconds.

entries.name: Spirit of Caliban
entries.text:
Powered Melee Kills trigger an Ignition.
Ignition does not benefit from Melee Damage Increases.

entries.name: Spirit of the Coyote
entries.text: Grants an extra Class Ability Charge.

entries.name: Spirit of Galanor
entries.text:
Super Hits and Kills refund Super Energy.
Refunds up to 50% Super Energy.
Silkstrike and Golden Gun can only refund up to 30%.

Needs testing across all 5 Super Abilities :(

entries.name: Spirit of the Cyrtarachne
entries.text:
On Grenade Ability Usage:
Grants Woven Mail for 10 seconds.

entries.name: Spirit of Renewal
entries.text:
While inside a Duskfield Grenade's Slowing Field:
Enemies deal 50% [20%] decreased damage.
User and allies are immediately granted x1 Frost Armor.
Grants an additional Frost Armor stack every 0.5 seconds.

entries.name: Spirit of the Gyrfalcon
entries.text:
Upon leaving Void Invisibility:
Grants Volatile Rounds for 9 [3] seconds.

entries.name: Spirit of the Dragon
entries.text:
Passively grants +10 Stability and 0.?x Ready Duration Multiplier.

On Class Ability Usage:
Grants Wraithmetal Mail for 9 seconds.
Reloads all weapons and picks up Ammo Bricks within 15 meters. Activates On-Reload Perks.

Wraithmetal Mail:
+35 Stability and +? Handling.

entries.name: Spirit of the Liar
entries.text:
Receiving Melee Damage, or scoring a Powered Melee Hit grants Cross Counter for the next Melee Hit within 3 seconds.

Cross Counter grants 400% increased Basic and Arc Melee Damage.
Cross Counter's Melee Attack deals Arc Damage.

entries.name: Spirit of the Foetracer
entries.text:
Upon dealing Ability Damage to an Elite, Miniboss, Champion, Boss, or Guardian:
Grants x4 Ability Element-Matching Weapon Surge for 16 [11] seconds.
Buff is not refreshable.

entries.name: Spirit of the Wormhusk
entries.text:
On Class Ability Usage:
Grants x2 Cure.

Upon reaching 100% Counter Progress by scoring multiple Kills within 3 seconds of each:
Rank-And-File = 34% | Elite+ and Guardians = 50%
Grants a stack of Burning Souls for 10 seconds, up to a maximum of 3 stacks.
All stacks expire at once. Retriggering Burning Souls refreshes the buff duration.

Burning Souls: Class Ability Usage healing is enhanced and spreads to allies within 15? meters:
x1 = x3 Cure.
x2 = x1 Cure + Restoration x1 for 3 seconds.
x3 = x2 Cure + Restoration x1 for 5 seconds.
If Restoration is active, then it will extend its duration by the corresponding duration.

entries.name: Spirit of Hoarfrost
entries.text:
On Barricade Placement:
Creates a Stasis Wall that is 5 medium crystals wide. The middle crystal is a small crystal.
Overrides Barricade Cooldown with Towering Barricade's?.

On Thruster Usage:
Spawns 2 Stasis Crystals.

Does not provide Rally Barricade Bonuses, unlike the Exotic Armor version.

entries.name: Spirit of Alpha Lupi
entries.text:
On Barricade Placement or Thruster Usage:
Instantly restores Health and Shields to the wielder and allies in Line of Sight within 12 metres.
Barricade restores 160 Health and 110 Shields. Thruster restores 30 Health.
Incurs a 5 second cooldown between healing pulses.

Healing Allies grants ?% Class Ability Energy.

entries.name: Spirit of Severance
entries.text:
On Powered Melee Kill or Finisher:
Enemy triggers a Kinetic Explosion, dealing up to 400 [?] damage over ? meters
Incurs a 1 second cooldown between non-chaining explosions.

Severance Explosions from Powered Melee Kills can chain, creating weaker explosions that only deal up to 268 [?] damage in a ? meter radius.
Chaining Explosions do not have a cooldown.

entries.name: Spirit of Contact
entries.text:
Upon scoring a Powered Melee Hit:
Enemies within 15 meters of the struck enemy are hit by lightning.
Lightning deals 181 [50] Arc Damage and inflicts Jolt.

entries.name: Spirit of the Abeyant
entries.text:
Enhances Drengr's Lash

Barricade:
Creates 2 additional Lashes.
Lashes now seek enemies more aggressively and travel ?% farther.

Thruster:
Knot lasts up to ? seconds, lobbing itself towards enemies within ? meters, and detonates on contact.

entries.name: Spirit of Scars
entries.text:
Upon scoring a Super-Element Matching Weapon Kill:
Grants x1 Restoration for 3+1.5 seconds to the wearer and allies within 15? metres.
Incurs a 3 second cooldown between activations.

entries.name: Spirit of the Bear
entries.text:
While guarding with Unbreakable:
15% Increased Movement Speed.

Unbreakable grants up to 60% Grenade Ability Energy once it ends.
Scales from 15% Grenade Energy, up to 60% Grenade Energy after maxing out Unbreakable.

entries.name: Spirit of the Armamentarium
entries.text: Grants an extra Grenade Ability Charge.

entries.name: Spirit of the Eternal Warrior
entries.text:
On Super End:
Grants x4 Super-Element Matching Weapon Surge for 30 [6?] seconds.

entries.name: Spirit of the Horn
entries.text:
On Barricade Placement:
Unleashes 3 Tracking Solar Wave that travel up to 18.5 metres away.
Solar Waves deal 480 [100] damage and applies x60 [x30] Scorch.
Solar Waves spawn a Sunspot under the enemies on hit [kill].

On Thruster Usage:
Releases a Solar Ball that explodes after ? seconds, releasing 4 Solar Waves in an X-pattern, using the aforementioned info.

entries.name: Spirit of Apotheosis
entries.text:
On Super Cast:
Fully restores Health, Grenade, Melee, and Class Ability Energy.
Caster and Allies within ? meters are granted Cure x3.

On Super End:
66% Fixed Bonus Grenade and Melee Ability Energy per second for 8 seconds.

entries.name: Spirit of Harmony
entries.text:
Upon scoring a Super-Element Matching Weapon Kill:
Grants additional Super Energy based on the Enemy Tier.
Tier 1 Combatant = 1.5% | T2 = 2% | T3 = ?% | T4 = 2.5% | Guardian = ?%

entries.name: Spirit of Osmiomancy
entries.text:
Coldsnap Grenades have better tracking, and travel 17.5% further and faster.

Coldsnap, Storm, Threadling, and Vortex Grenades grant Grenade Energy upon dealing damage.
Healing Grenades grant Fixed Grenade Energy upon healing the user or an ally.
Vortex Grenades have a ~0.8s cooldown between energy gains on a single target.

Coldsnap Grenade Ability Energy:
T1 Combatant = 10% | T2 = 22% | T3 = 34% | T4 = 50% | Guardian = 7%

Storm, Healing, Threadling, and Vortex Grenade Ability Energy:
T1 Combatant = 3% | T2 = 5.7% | T3 = 8.4% | T4 & Healing = 12% | Guardian = 5%

entries.name: Spirit of Starfire
entries.text:
While Radiant, in a Well of Radiance or Empowering Rift:
Grants 5% Fixed Grenade Energy per Weapon Hit.
Incurs a 0.4 seconds cooldown between Grenade Energy Gains.
Grants 15% Fixed Grenade Energy on Weapon Kill.

entries.name: Spirit of the Stag
entries.text:
Grants 25% [5%] Damage Resist to Guardians inside Rifts created by the wielder.
Standing in a Rift that overlaps or is inside a Well of Radiance allow the Damage Resist to work in it.

entries.name: Spirit of the Claw
entries.text: Grants an extra Melee Ability Charge.

entries.name: Spirit of the Filaments
entries.text:
Standing on Empowering Rifts created by the user grants Devour for 11 seconds.
Exiting, and then re-entering the same Empowering Rift refreshes the duration of Devour.
Secant Filaments' Devour can be refreshed to 11 seconds.

While Devour is active:
Kills grant 10% Class Ability Energy.

entries.name: Spirit of the Swarm
entries.text:
Upon destroying a Tangle:
Spawns 2 Threadlings.

entries.name: Spirit of the Necrotic
entries.text:
Melee Hits inflict Potent Corruption.
Corrupted enemies spread Potent Corruption on death in a 5 metre radius.

Potent Corrupted Damage ticks every 0.52 [0.7] seconds up to 19 [?] times over 10 [?] seconds, dealing 32 [5?] Kinetic Damage every tick, totalling 640 [?] damage over its duration.

entries.name: Spirit of Vesper
entries.text:
After 1 second of placing a Rift:
Triggers an Arc Shockwave that deals 360 [100] Arc Damage and staggers in a 7.5 metres radius.
Additional shockwaves occur every 5 seconds, until the Rift expires.

While an Arc Super Ability is equipped, shockwaves blind.
